locator.name: IDENTITY MISMATCH: while parent is in a turn is held and flushed when parent turn ends, with zero seat wakes

proves.facet: Demonstrates a mismatch line is held while a non-steering parent is in a turn and flushed on parent turn end with zero seat wakes.
Demonstrates worker, reviewer, and curator turns ending with IDENTITY MISMATCH: deliver immediately to the idle parent with zero wakes, no 60s wait, and unincremented silentEnds.

1.note:
Extraction tests cover plain, trimmed, and Markdown-wrapped prefixes, interior backtick preservation, 300-character truncation, and lowercase, mid-line, empty, and unreadable rejections.

Anchor: `extractIdentityMismatchLine`

2.note:
All three leaf roles (`worker`, `reviewer`, `curator`) deliver mismatch lines immediately to an idle parent with zero timers, zero seat wakes, unchanged `silentEnds`, and an `identity-mismatch` log row.

Anchor: `noteTurnEnded`

3.note:
Wrapped mismatch lines strip symmetric outer quotes and backticks cleanly, preserve pre-existing `silentEnds`, and match `composeIdentityMismatchParentLine`.

Anchor: `composeIdentityMismatchParentLine`

4.note:
Parent-routing cases verify hold-and-flush while the parent is in a turn, Manager fallback when the parent is archived, cancellation of an open declared wait, and intact 60 s silent-end handling.

Anchor: `noteTurnStarted`; `noteAgentArchived`; `openDeclaredWait`
